Minutes if you buy both items on the Market; many attempts (rare drops and trades) if you get them yourself. The base outfit requires the Podzilla Quest to be completed (several days).

The {wiki:Rootwalker Outfits|Rootwalker Outfits} are earned in {wiki:Podzilla|Podzilla}, the giant carnivorous plant advancing across the sea towards the mainland. The base outfit is the final reward of the {wiki:Podzilla Quest|Podzilla Quest}, after you defeat {creature:The Rootkraken}. The 1st addon is obtained by using a {item:Strange Inedible Fruit} (rare drop from the Rootkraken) and the 2nd by using a {item:Petrified Leaf} (comes rarely from the tea trade with {npc:Petaloid}). With the full outfit you earn the achievement **The Rootwalker**.
Captain Seahorse, Edron harbour (boat to Podzilla)

Loot from {creature:The Rootkraken}: 1–3 {item:Crystal Coin|Crystal Coins}, 50–100 {item:Platinum Coin|Platinum Coins}, potions, gems, ambers and, rarely, {item:Collar of Orange Plasma}, {item:Root Tentacle}, {item:Amber Sabre}, {item:Amber Bludgeon}, {item:Amber Greataxe} or {item:Amber Kusarigama}; on the first victory, always an {item:Amber Crusher}
Addons 1 and 2 of the Rootwalker Outfits
By using the {item:Strange Inedible Fruit} (addon 1) and the {item:Petrified Leaf} (addon 2), once you already have the base outfit from the {wiki:Podzilla Quest|Podzilla Quest}.
Both items can be bought on the Market.

The {item:Strange Inedible Fruit} and the {item:Petrified Leaf} are **tradeable** (Market) and no NPC buys or sells them. If you do not want to hunt them, buy them from other players: the effect is the same. The base outfit, however, always requires the completed Podzilla Quest.
The {item:Strange Inedible Fruit} is very rare: in the wiki statistics it dropped **once in 59** kills of {creature:The Rootkraken} (about 1.7%).

The {item:Processed Blue Tea Leaves} are **not part of the loot**: they appear at random **on the ground, under the corpse** of Quaras killed in the underwater part of Podzilla. Look at the ground after each kill. They are not sold on the Market either.

Podzilla's Quaras ({creature:Quara Raider}, {creature:Quara Looter}, {creature:Quara Plunderer}) are **immune to ice** and take extra **earth** and **energy** damage. The {creature:Quara Looter} casts chain damage that gets stronger for each player it hits: the wiki considers it the most dangerous Quara in Podzilla for groups.
{creature:The Rootkraken} takes extra **fire** (115%) and **earth** (110%) damage and less **energy** (85%), according to the wiki (values still marked as unconfirmed).

{wiki:Podzilla|Podzilla} is a giant plant in the sea. You can only get inside by boat, from **Edron**, with {npc:Captain Seahorse}. If you have already done the Podzilla Quest, you have the shortcut ({key:shortcut}) and can skip the first-trip steps.

If you are not in **Edron**, take a boat: talk to the captain at your city's harbour (for example {npc:Captain Bluebear} in Thais) and say {key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes}. You arrive at Edron harbour, **north** of the city, next to {npc:Captain Seahorse}.

If you have not started the {wiki:Podzilla Quest|Podzilla Quest} yet, go to {wiki:Edron Castle|Edron Castle} and talk to {npc:Gunther} ({key:hi}). He tells you he saw a huge plant moving in the open sea, heading for the mainland. Accept his invitation to destroy it and go back to {npc:Captain Seahorse}'s boat.
First time: the voyage to Podzilla

Talk to {npc:Captain Seahorse} about Gunther ({key:hi}, {key:gunther}) and board. On the boat, use the **lever** to start: sail **west** to the giant plant and enter through its **mouth**. On the way there are {wiki:Storm|Storms}, {wiki:Water Vortex|Water Vortexes} and {wiki:Ghost Ship|Ghost Ships} that lower your counter; they cast many area spells and can make you {wiki:Feared|feared}, so do not sail near them.
If the counter reaches **zero**, you fail and have to try again later: you can only retry **10 minutes** after a failure.
After the first successful trip, ask {npc:Captain Seahorse} for a shortcut ({key:hi}, {key:shortcut}). From then on you do not need to repeat the voyage to get into Podzilla.

You disembark on Podzilla's **ground floor**, next to {npc:Atui}. From here: the **green teleport to the north-west** of the ground floor leads to the stairs that go up to {npc:Two Lips} and {npc:Petaloid} (floor +1). The **hunting area** (floors -1 to -4) is entered through the **vortex teleport**; on floor -2 is the {npc:Sprout Sentinel} and on floor -3 the teleport for the *Coin Toss* mission.
2. Base outfit: complete the Podzilla Quest
The base outfit is the final reward of the {wiki:Podzilla Quest|Podzilla Quest}. Here is a summary of the missions; for all the details, follow that quest's guide.
Do the missions in this order. The two lever tasks (*Protect the Bloom* and *For The Sprout*) are rooms for **5 players**.
Accept Gunther's invitation; say {key:gunther} to the captain
Sail west and enter the plant's mouth
{npc:Two Lips}, floor +1 (green teleport to the north-west)
Eat a {item:Demon Root} and offer Two Lips your help
Kill the 13 {wiki:Rootthing Buckler|Rootthing Bucklers}, break the shield and cut 10 roots with {item:Amber Sickle|Amber Sickles}; go back to Two Lips ({key:worth})
Score 100 points by killing {wiki:Invader Bug|Invader Bugs} with planted flowers
Use {item:Potent Dew|Potent Dews} on the Plant Heart until the counter reaches 1
Kill 100 {wiki:Pest Bug|Pest Bugs} with the energy from the green vortexes

Kill 20 {creature:Pupated Rootthing|Pupated Rootthings} or {creature:Enraged Pupated Rootthing|Enraged Pupated Rootthings} that come out of the cocoons (the cocoons only exist for 2 hours after someone cuts the roots of the Crimson Death Blossom)
Clear a path through the labyrinth and destroy the {wiki:Powergenerator|Powergenerator} with {item:Gold Coin|Gold Coins}

The final fight is against {creature:The Rootkraken} and {creature:Doctor Marrow (Podzilla)|Doctor Marrow}. It is the same fight you will repeat to try for the {item:Strange Inedible Fruit}: the way to the room and the mechanics are explained in **section 3**. On the first victory the loot **always** includes an {item:Amber Crusher}.
Go back to {npc:Two Lips} (ground floor → green teleport to the north-west → go up the stairs) and say {key:hi} and {key:leader}. You receive the base {wiki:Rootwalker Outfits|Rootwalker Outfit}.

The {item:Strange Inedible Fruit} only drops from {creature:The Rootkraken}, and rarely (about 1.7% in the wiki statistics). Since you have already done the Podzilla Quest, you can return to the fight with your team whenever you like. The wiki does not give the waiting time between fights.
Quick option: buy on the Market
Search for **Strange Inedible Fruit** on the Market at any depot and buy it. No NPC sells or buys it; the price is negotiated between players. If you buy it, skip to the last step of this section.

In Podzilla, enter the hunting area through the vortex teleport and go down to **floor -3**. Go to the teleport of the *Coin Toss* mission: **just south** of it is the **shortcut** you earned by completing that mission, an **orb**.

Click the **orb** and go down the stairs to the last floor. Continue to the **central area**, where the **lever** for the fight against {creature:The Rootkraken} is. Gather the team and use the lever.

Equip protection against **physical** and **death** damage; **earth** protection only when {creature:Doctor Marrow (Podzilla)|Doctor Marrow} is attacking you. Bring **{item:Gold Coin|Gold Coins}** (they are needed for the Powergenerator) and, if you like, seeds to plant Blooming Towers (see further below). {creature:The Rootkraken} gives 700,000 experience, sees invisible and cannot be paralysed (Bosstiary: Archfoe).
Without Gold Coins you cannot destroy the Powergenerator and the bosses stay immune to damage.
Phase 1 — charge yourself at the green vortexes

When you enter, you and the team are in a room with {creature:The Rootkraken} and {creature:Doctor Marrow (Podzilla)|Doctor Marrow}. **Both are immune to damage** at the start: do not waste time on them. Go up the **west**, **north** or **east** stairs, kill the {wiki:Writhing Mass|Writhing Masses} and step on the **green vortexes** that appear when they die: you become charged with corrupted energy and start casting waves and beams on your own (as in the *For The Sprout* mission).

Once charged, go up the **south** stairs and position yourself to destroy the {creature:Rampant Barrier|Rampant Barriers} with the automatic spells. Repeat (going back to the vortexes to recharge) until you reach the {wiki:Powergenerator|Powergenerator}, then destroy it by throwing a {item:Gold Coin} at it, as in the *Coin Toss* mission.
Over time, summoned plants keep appearing in the room, which makes the trips back and forth more and more dangerous.

With the Powergenerator destroyed, both bosses now take damage: the goal is to kill {creature:The Rootkraken}. It deals mostly **physical** damage, some **death**, and can leave you **rooted**. {creature:Doctor Marrow (Podzilla)|Doctor Marrow} deals mostly **earth** damage, a lot of **physical**, and can make you **rooted**, **feared** and **superdrunk**. Lure Doctor Marrow to the **opposite side** of the room from where you are attacking the Rootkraken: that way the Knight tanks better and does not get feared. Fight in the **south/south-west** corner of the room, where the walls help to trap the boss.
You can hit Doctor Marrow, but when he gets to about half health he runs away: it is not worth focusing him.

During the fight, waves of plants appear ({creature:Rotten Plant Thing}, {creature:Angry Plant Thing}, {creature:Frenzied Plant Thing}) that deal **physical**, **earth** and **death** damage and keep **evolving** up to the Frenzied state. In the Frenzied state they increase the *stacks* of the player they attack: the more stacks you have, the more damage you take from **everything** in the fight. The minimum is 100 stacks, and they drop by 10 every 4 seconds.
Do not let all the plants reach the Frenzied state on the same person.

There are patches of **soil** spread around the room where you can plant Blooming Towers, as in the *Protect the Bloom* mission. It is not required, but it deals extra damage to the boss and helps control the plants. Here you have to bring your own seeds: they drop from the rootthings and Quaras on Podzilla's first floors.

Open {creature:The Rootkraken}'s corpse. The {item:Strange Inedible Fruit} is rare: if it does not drop, try again in another fight (or buy it on the Market). Main loot items (wiki statistics, 59 kills):
Loot from The Rootkraken (may include the Strange Inedible Fruit)

The wiki does not describe how to leave the Rootkraken room after the fight (the lever takes you into it). Once you are back on the last floor, return the same way: the stairs next to the arrival point go up to floor -3, beside the orb and the *Coin Toss* teleport; from there, go up through the hunting-area floors to Podzilla's ground floor.

With the base outfit already unlocked, **use** the {item:Strange Inedible Fruit} (right-click → *Use*). Your character becomes **Drunk**, lets out the sound *"Uhghhh!"* and the message *"What of 'inedible' was so hard to understand? However your outfit improved."* appears: you receive the **1st addon** of the Rootwalker Outfits.

The {item:Petrified Leaf} does not drop from any creature. You get it, with a **rare** chance, when you trade 20 {item:Processed Blue Tea Leaves} for a {item:Podzilla's Finest} with {npc:Petaloid}. It can also be bought on the Market.
Quick option: buy on the Market
Search for **Petrified Leaf** on the Market and buy it. No NPC sells or buys it. If you buy it, skip to the last step of this section.

Hunt the Quaras in the **underwater part** of Podzilla ({creature:Quara Raider}, {creature:Quara Looter} and {creature:Quara Plunderer}). They are in the hunting area (enter through the vortex teleport on the ground floor): the wiki places them in the *Podzilla Underwater* and *Podzilla Bottom* areas and says there are Quaras right on the first floors, but gives no coordinates. At random, {item:Processed Blue Tea Leaves} appear **on the ground, under the corpse** of the dead Quara (they are not in the loot). Pick them up until you have **20**. Each one weighs 1.50 oz and they are stackable.

The Quaras are immune to **ice**; {creature:Quara Raider} and {creature:Quara Plunderer} attack in melee and {creature:Quara Looter} attacks from a distance, with chain damage that increases for each player hit (be careful in a group). Use **earth** or **energy** damage.
The leaves are not tradeable: you will not find them on the Market, so you have to hunt them yourself (or ask another player for them directly).
Go back to Podzilla's **ground floor**, enter the **green teleport to the north-west** and go up the stairs. {npc:Petaloid} is on the same floor as {npc:Two Lips}, a little to the **east** of him.

Petaloid is a rootthing, one of the *plant people*: in the Podzilla Quest you had to eat a {item:Demon Root} to be able to talk to them. The wiki does not say whether you need to eat another one to talk to Petaloid: if he does not understand you, eat one (it drops from Podzilla's rootthings or you can buy it on the Market; it makes you Drunk for 1 minute).
Trade the leaves for Podzilla's Finest

Talk to {npc:Petaloid} ({key:hi}) and open his trade list, as with any NPC shop ({key:trade}); the wiki has no transcript for this NPC. He gives a {item:Podzilla's Finest} for **20 {item:Processed Blue Tea Leaves}**. Each trade has a **rare** chance of also giving you a {item:Petrified Leaf}. If it does not come, collect another 20 leaves and repeat.
The {item:Podzilla's Finest} is an exotic tea; it is not tradeable.

With the base outfit already unlocked, **use** the {item:Petrified Leaf} (the item description says Rootwalkers can use it to improve their attire). You receive the **2nd addon** of the Rootwalker Outfits.

With **both addons** you earn the achievement **The Rootwalker** (2 points): *"Traversing the innards of Podzilla was a conquest in and by itself, thanks to Two Lips you are now one with the plant biosphere as you stride its many intertwined trails."*
Official artwork of the Rootwalker Outfits

The wiki does not document the return trip from Podzilla to Edron. If you are in the hunting area, go back up the same way to the **ground floor**; from there, the natural route is to return to the ship you arrived on, next to {npc:Atui}. Once in Edron, {npc:Captain Seahorse} takes you by boat to Ab'Dendriel, Ankrahmun, Carlin, Cormaya, Liberty Bay, Port Hope, Thais, Travora or Venore (Oramond only with the *Citizen* rank from the Rathleton Quest). To return to Podzilla another day, ask him for the {key:shortcut}.

Summary: **base outfit** = complete the {wiki:Podzilla Quest|Podzilla Quest} and say {key:leader} to {npc:Two Lips}; **addon 1** = use a {item:Strange Inedible Fruit} (rare drop from {creature:The Rootkraken}); **addon 2** = use a {item:Petrified Leaf} (rare trade with {npc:Petaloid}). Both items are sold on the Market.
Achievement **The Rootwalker**: 2 points, Premium, not secret; earned with both addons.
The outfit, the Podzilla Quest and the addon items were added in version 13.40 (Summer Update 2024).

The {item:Amber Crusher}, which always drops on the first victory against the Rootkraken, is used to break {wiki:Wheel of Destiny|Wheel of Destiny} gems into {item:Lesser Fragment|Lesser Fragments} and {item:Greater Fragment|Greater Fragments}.
